threats.title: Data Interception / Eavesdropping Risk on GuestClient->EdgeGateway
threats.description: Flow 'GuestClient->EdgeGateway' from 'GuestClient' to 'EdgeGateway' crosses a trust boundary over HTTPS and requires strict TLS 1.2+ certificate validation to prevent sensitive data exposure.
threats.mitigation: Enforce TLS 1.3 with strict certificate validation and mutual workload identity.

threats.title: Identity Spoofing / Session Hijacking at GuestClient->EdgeGateway
threats.description: Entry flow 'GuestClient->EdgeGateway' from 'GuestClient' could be targeted by credential stuffing or forged tokens.
threats.mitigation: Enforce OIDC/OAuth2 session tokens, MFA for staff roles, and short-lived JWT validation.

threats.title: In-Transit Payload Modification on GuestClient->EdgeGateway
threats.description: Requests or records traversing 'GuestClient->EdgeGateway' across trust zones could be replayed or modified.
threats.mitigation: Enforce cryptographic payload integrity checks, idempotency keys, and mTLS.
